subject: Orion Telecom RFP - SOC 2 / ISO / SIG evidence and clarifications
messages:
From: Aisha Malik <aisha.malik@orion-telecom.com>
To: laura@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@orion-telecom.com, security@orion-telecom.com
Date: Wed, 14 Jul 2026 08:12:00 -0400
Subject: Request: SOC 2 & ISO evidence for RFP - Orion Telecom

Hi Laura,

Thanks for the quick intro last week — Orion's procurement team has opened an RFP thread for our platform vendors. As part of the security/compliance section we need the following from Redwood to move to the next stage:

- SOC 2 Type II report (most recent, redacted copies acceptable)
- ISO 27001 scope statement and current certificate page
- SIG questionnaire (we attached the spreadsheet in the RFP; respond to control mapping where applicable)
- List of active subprocessors and data residency options for EU customers
- Confirmation of encryption at rest for embeddings and customer-managed key options

Can you confirm whether you can deliver these artifacts by EOD Friday (2026-07-16)? If not, please propose a timeline and any clarifying questions.

Attachment: Orion_RFP_2026.pdf (RFP bundle, 42 pages)

Appreciate it — we can schedule a quick call Thursday if helpful.

Best,
Aisha Malik
Head of Procurement, Orion Telecom

From: laura@redwood.com (Laura Bennett)
To: markus@redwood.com, neha@redwood.com
Cc: laura@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 14 Jul 2026 10:03:00 -0400
Subject: Fwd: Request: SOC 2 & ISO evidence for RFP - Orion Telecom

Markus / Neha — forwarding inbound RFP from Orion (see attached). Key asks in the security section (SOC2, ISO, SIG, subprocessors, encryption at rest + CMEK). They want artifacts by EOD Friday 7/16.

Immediate items and owners:
- SOC 2 redacted PDF + signoff note (Markus)
- ISO 27001 scope/cert page (Neha)
- SIG control mapping (Markus + me) — we should pre-populate answers for the 50 most relevant controls, mark residuals as "mitigating controls" where appropriate
- Subprocessor list + data residency options (Neha)
- Short Q&A on embeddings encryption / CMEK (Markus)

Plan: I'll prepare a concise summary email to Orion with attachments and a link to a shared folder. Markus, can you populate the control mapping draft and drop it into the shared Drive by EOD Thursday so I can QA on Friday morning? Neha, please pull the latest subprocessor CSV and ISO scope doc.

I'll loop in Sales if procurement requests pricing/credits — don't escalate unless they ask for contract redlines.

Thanks — Laura
Laura Bennett
Head of Security & Trust, Redwood Inference
laura@redwood.com

From: Markus Klein <markus@redwood.com>
To: laura@redwood.com
Cc: neha@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 15 Jul 2026 09:22:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: SOC 2 & ISO evidence for RFP - Orion Telecom

Laura — attaching the first pass of the control mapping for Orion. I focused on the SIG sections they flagged (Access Control, Data Protection, Vendor Management, Logging & Monitoring). Highlights:

- SOC 2 coverage: majority of SIG confidentiality/integrity controls map to our SOC 2 Type II (in-scope systems: inference runtime, control plane, console). Where SOC 2 is not a direct match, I added a compensating control reference (e.g., encryption key rotation policy + automated audits).
- ISO: scope statement confirms EU processing of embeddings for customers who select EU region — included cert page.
- Embeddings encryption: we support AES-256 at rest for model weights and customer data; for embeddings, we can enable CMEK for Dedicated and Private customers. Hosted API customers can use envelope encryption; we'll clarify that we do not ingest customer proprietary keys in hosted shared tiers.

Attachments: redwood_control_map_for_orion.xlsx (draft, contains per-control mapping and evidence pointer column)
Other attachments (pushed to shared folder): SOC2_TypeII_Redacted_2025.pdf, ISO27001_scope_statement.docx

I also added a short "open questions" list at the top of the mapping:
1) Does Orion require full unredacted SOC 2?
2) Do they need CMEK for hosted API or only Dedicated/Private?
3) Any specific retention timeframes beyond our standard 90-day embedding cache?

I can be on the Thur/Fri call to walk the mapping if needed.

—Markus
Principal Security Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: laura@redwood.com <laura@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Malik <aisha.malik@orion-telecom.com>
Cc: security@orion-telecom.com, procurement@orion-telecom.com, markus@redwood.com, neha@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 16 Jul 2026 11:04:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Request: SOC 2 & ISO evidence for RFP - Orion Telecom

Hi Aisha,

Thanks for the RFP — attached is a consolidated packet we prepared for Orion ahead of the Friday deadline. I've summarized the salient points below so your team can quickly triage. If you'd like a walkthrough, I'm available 16:30–17:30 ET for a 30-minute call.

Summary (high level):
- SOC 2 Type II (redacted): covers security, availability, and confidentiality controls for our hosted and dedicated runtimes. Redacted PDF attached: SOC2_TypeII_Redacted_2025.pdf. Evidence pointers are referenced in the control mapping.
- ISO 27001: scope statement and cert page attached: ISO27001_scope_statement.docx. Our scope includes platform control plane and inference services; we included statement on EU processing.
- SIG Questionnaire: completed spreadsheet attached: SIG-complete-responses-2026.xlsx. For a subset of vendor-specific controls we included compensating control descriptions and remediation timelines where work is in progress.
- Control mapping: redwood_control_map_for_orion.xlsx ties SIG items to SOC 2/ISO evidence and includes direct links to artifacts in the shared folder.
- Subprocessors & data residency: attached CSV in Drive. Short answer: EU data residency supported via our EU region; Dedicated & Private deployments support customer-controlled KMS.
- Embeddings encryption / CMEK: embeddings stored with AES-256 at rest. CMEK is available for Dedicated and Private customers; for Hosted API we offer envelope encryption and can discuss stricter options under enterprise contract.

Attachments (included in packet): SOC2_TypeII_Redacted_2025.pdf (redacted), ISO27001_scope_statement.docx, SIG-complete-responses-2026.xlsx, redwood_control_map_for_orion.xlsx
Related links: https://drive.redwood.com/shared/Orion-RFP/Evidence/ (folder with raw artifacts)

Open items / clarifications we need from Orion:
- Do you require unredacted SOC 2 or is the redacted copy sufficient for procurement review?
- Specific embedding retention requirements (if >90 days are needed, we'll propose an SLA change)
- Any required addenda for EU data processing that must be included in the SOW/contract?

If those items are OK, our recommended next step is a 30-minute call to review the SIG mapping and clarify the CMEK scope. I'm available 16:30 ET today or otherwise next Monday.

Best regards,
Laura Bennett
Head of Security & Trust
Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0123

Attachment stubs: SOC2_TypeII_Redacted_2025.pdf (PDF, redacted), ISO27001_scope_statement.docx (DOCX), SIG-complete-responses-2026.xlsx (XLSX), redwood_control_map_for_orion.xlsx (XLSX)

From: Aisha Malik <aisha.malik@orion-telecom.com>
To: laura@redwood.com
Cc: security@orion-telecom.com, procurement@orion-telecom.com
Date: Fri, 16 Jul 2026 15:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Request: SOC 2 & ISO evidence for RFP - Orion Telecom

Laura — thank you, this is very helpful and timely. Procurement will accept the redacted SOC 2 for initial evaluation. We have a couple of clarifying items for the call:

1) We will want to confirm whether CMEK for embeddings can be documented in the SOW for a hosted deployment (we expect this might be a commercial add-on).
2) We will ask Security to deep-dive into your compensating controls for the three SIG items marked "in-progress".

I'll schedule the 30-minute walkthrough for Monday 19 Jul 10:00 GMT (please confirm availability for Markus and Neha).

Best,
Aisha Malik
Head of Procurement, Orion Telecom
